note: Where each author works, taken from the role line their own piece prints under the byline, and from nothing else. This file is a TRANSCRIPTION, not a derivation: a one-line regular expression over free prose produced plausible nonsense here — a country, a summit, a description of a person — and a plausible affiliation is indistinguishable from a true one once it is in a graph. So every line was read and written out by hand, and build/gates.py checks each against the frozen bytes: the role line must appear in the article verbatim, and every organisation must appear inside the role line verbatim.
scope: Current affiliations only, as the role line states them. Where a role line names only former posts, no organisation is recorded and the reason is on the entry. No organisation is looked up anywhere else, and nobody's employment history is held.
